notes: Orb press-and-hold fix: holding the floating orb to jump back to the Muse app no longer turns into a drag when your finger drifts a little. The drag trigger is now properly scaled (12dp), small drift no longer cancels the hold, and only a clear move (40dp) before the half-second is up counts as a drag — while deciding, the orb stays pinned. Tap still toggles mute; drag-to-dismiss unchanged. Plus everything in 3.7.5 and earlier.
